items.title: U.S. Stocks Up as Dow Leaps
items.summary: STOCKS  Oil prices have reversed course and the Dow industrials has jumped after Scott Bessent said a deal with Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz could come “today or tomorrow.” Before his comments, investor confidence in the negotiations had been tested by conflicting messages on the status of talks and a fresh attack in the strait.
